title: The Lanterns Answer Together

source_theme.indexing_basis: Flatten melody_bars omitting rests; repeat the original core motif first four notes three times, one octave lower for PSG2.

caption: Original monophonic handheld makers-assembly jingle. Preserve the supplied twelve-note Promise-of-the-Lantern motif and exact timing. One warm square lead, three short calls, no chords, backing parts, vocals or fade.
note_origin: Original main theme leitmotif as reused in HORIZONS, then arranged one octave lower for the fixed twelve-note 180-update PSG2 contract.

leitmotif.description_ja: 共同体の作業場だけ、メインテーマの最初の4音を1オクターブ低く3回返す短い合図。12音・180更新のゲーム動作を維持。

identity_description_ja: 共同体の作業場の短い合図。主題の4音を低い矩形波で3回返します。
